nf1fc58cf92.headline: Eesti Lihatööstus went bankrupt
nf1fc58cf92.summary: The cooperative Eesti Lihatööstus, located in Vastse-Kuuste, Estonia, was declared bankrupt by the Tartu County Court.
nf1fc58cf92.why: Bankruptcy of a local meat producer affects the Estonian food sector and regional employment, reflecting challenges in the agricultural and food processing industries.

n16a699bec4.headline: National Bank: Ukraine's international reserves amounted to $20.2 billion at the end of February
n16a699bec4.summary: Ukraine's international reserves stood at $20.2 billion at the end of February, covering more than three months of imports.
n16a699bec4.why: International reserves are critical for a country's financial stability and ability to meet external obligations, influencing investor confidence.
